_comment: Reference-target credentials only. These are the public, documented logins
printed on the saucedemo login page itself, which is why they may be committed.
Nothing else belongs in this file: LocalSecretStore refuses to serve any path
outside qa/saucedemo/, and real credentials resolve from Vault at runtime (§11).
Path shape matches Vault KV v2: <root>/<accountType>/<role>/<n>.
